checks.meaning: attack 0x17: weapon (type 3, subtype 6) — checked before class/kind
jne -> unarmed branch when no parity subtype matched

projectile_checks.meaning: mov al, byte ptr [esi+0x68] (current attack id, wand/bracelet trail gate)
cmp al, 0x2c (wand wind-up action, specialist branch)
mov al, byte ptr [esi+0x68] (second trail gate)
cmp byte ptr [esi+0x68], 0x26 (muzzle length special case)
cmp byte ptr [eax+0x68], 0x68 (bomb: fixed range instead of raycast)

unknown.projectile_flight: no flying projectile entity in the decoded code: the ranged hit is a raycast from the muzzle position and the visible projectile is a swept mesh rebuilt every frame (render_build_projectile_mesh). Speed, gravity and lifetime of arrow.cub / wood-boomerang1.cub are NOT constants of Cube.exe and stay UNKNOWN.
unknown.muzzle_owner: the muzzle gates are keyed on the current action id (+0x68), which carries both the wind-up action and the release attack id; which weapon is holding the attack at the moment of the gate is PARTIAL.
unknown.arrow_model: subtypes 9 (arrow) and 14 (quiver) are drawn as held items only; no draw site for them as a flying mesh was found.
